item.title: Adani Energy Solutions bags Rs 18,000 crore project in Q3 FY26, expands transmission network
item.description: The company expanded its transmission network to nearly 27,900 circuit kilometres and improved efficiency across its distribution business, with lower losses and high supply reliability. AESL also made rapid progress in smart metering, nearing its target of one crore installations by FY26, supported by a robust order book and steady income growth.

item.title: O Romeo trailer: Farida Jalal on using cuss word in film; where she drew the line
item.description: Farida Jalal grabbed attention for using a cuss word in one of the dialogues in the teaser of Vishal Bhardwaj's O Romeo. In a recent interview, she addressed the controversy and shared her thoughts behind the bold choice.

item.title: Who is Achraf Hakimi: Moroccan footballer Nora Fatehi is allegedly dating & their age gap
item.description: Nora Fatehi is the latest celebrity to have allegedly been bitten by love. Here's everything you need to know about Achraf Hakimi, Nora Fatehi's rumoured boyfriend and the captain of the Moroccan national football team. He was previously married to Spanish actress Hiba Abouk from 2020 to 2023 and has two sons with her.

item.title: CMF Headphone Pro launched for Rs 6,999: 5 best features you shouldn't miss
item.description: CMF by Nothing has launched its first over-ear ANC headphones in India, combining modular design, tactile controls, adaptive noise cancellation and a claimed 100-hour battery life at a competitive price.

item.title: After 'white-collar terror' bust, J&K begins massive profiling of mosques, madrasas
item.description: In the wake of a major crackdown on a "white-collar" terror module involving doctors and students, Jammu and Kashmir authorities have launched an extensive profiling drive of mosques, madrasas, and religious functionaries.

item.title: Trump calls Fed chief Jerome Powell 'lousy', defends ICE agent
item.description: Trump also defended an ICE agent involved in a fatal Minnesota incident, blaming illegal immigration and backing enforcement actions. He acknowledged ongoing cost-of-living pressures but said inflation had eased and manufacturing and jobs were growing.

item.title: Sensex, Nifty open lower over FII outflows, crude prices rise
item.description: As of 9.25 am, Sensex slipped 74 points, or 0.09 per cent to 83,552 and Nifty eased 12 points, or 0.05 per cent to 25,719. Main broad-cap indices showed slight divergence with benchmark indices, with the Nifty Midcap 100 unchanged, while the Nifty Smallcap 100 added 0.48 per cent.

item.title: Delhi's minimum temperature rises slightly; air quality remains 'very poor'
item.description: Delhi's minimum temperature rose slightly to 3.8°C on Wednesday, but cold wave conditions continued across the city. Air quality remained a major concern, with the overall AQI at 360 and several areas recording 'very poor' to 'severe' pollution levels.

item.title: US courts fault ICE detentions of Indian nationals
item.description: Judges ordered releases or prompt bond hearings, rejecting the use of mandatory detention for individuals already living in the US. The courts held that parole or bond cannot be revoked without notice and justification. The rulings reinforce that immigration enforcement must comply with constitutional due process protections.

item.title: Anaganaga Oka Raju movie review: Naveen Polishetty's comedy timing wows audience
item.description: Anaganaga Oka Rajuhary has received mixed reviews and ratings from the audience, who say that Naveen Polishetty's comedy works well.
